sources.name: Greenhouse job boards
sources.notes: List is 59 KB for 83 jobs; content=true is 845 KB, so bodies are fetched per job at /jobs/{id} only for postings that survive the metadata gate. No ETag offered when checked. A wrong token is 404.

sources.name: Lever job boards
sources.notes: One request returns descriptions, workplaceType and a two-letter country. The only platform of the three that returned an ETag and answered a conditional request with 304.

sources.name: Ashby job boards
sources.notes: One request returns descriptionPlain, workplaceType and isRemote. isListed=false postings are skipped. A wrong token returns a plain-text 404, not JSON.

sources.name: RemoteOK
sources.notes: Bare array whose FIRST element is a legal notice rather than a job.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.notes: RSS, not JSON. Title is "Company: Role" and is the only place the company name appears.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.notes: jobs[] alongside two legal-notice keys. candidate_required_location is a restriction, not a location.

sources.name: Working Nomads
sources.notes: Bare array; tags is a comma-separated string rather than a list.

sources.name: Adzuna
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. Covers 19 countries; a selected country outside that set is reported rather than dropped silently. Country x term queries capped per run and rotating. CORRECTION to plan §3.2, which assumes aggregators usually expose an 'apply on the company site' link: Adzuna's redirect_url is adzuna.com/details/<id> or /land/ad/<id>?se=...&v=... with nothing embedded, so identity rule 1 can never fire for an Adzuna sighting. Its copies merge on company+title+country or on the description fingerprint, or not at all.

sources.name: Jooble
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. POST with a JSON body; the key is in the URL path and never reaches an error line. Location x term queries capped and rotating.

sources.name: Careerjet
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20, with TWO CORRECTIONS. The endpoint is plain HTTP: it refuses TLS outright (connection refused on 443) and answers on port 80, so the affiliate key travels in plaintext. And it rejects an undeclared caller with 403 and the body 'Undeclared referrer. Please add a Referer header so we know who is calling this API and from which page.' - so the connector declares itself with a Referer naming the project, which is the same honest-identification rule as the User-Agent. Locale x term queries capped and rotating.

sources.name: Reed
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. HTTP Basic with the key as username; dd/mm/yyyy dates. Only asked when the saved search includes the UK.

sources.name: USAJobs
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. Needs the key AND the registered email, which goes in the User-Agent header.

sources.name: The Muse
sources.notes: CORRECTION to Appendix A, which lists this as free-key: the public endpoint answers with no key at all. A key raises the rate limit rather than unlocking access.

sources.name: SmartRecruiters
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. {content:[...]}. The postings list carries NO description, so these records score on their title and report experience as not stated. A detail fetch per posting would fix that and is a Phase 2 refinement.

sources.name: Workable
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. {jobs:[...]}, country and city as separate fields, full descriptions. The richest of the six: experience extracts cleanly from its bodies.

sources.name: Recruitee
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. {offers:[...]}, HTML descriptions, country_code, and its own remote/hybrid/on_site flags.

sources.name: BambooHR
sources.notes: Official ATS jobs API is per-company but requires an authenticated caller with ATS access; it is not an anonymous discovery endpoint. Verified from BambooHR's Get Job Summaries reference 2026-08-23.

sources.name: Teamtailor
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-24. Anonymous JSON Feed 1.1 with full HTML description, exact publication timestamp and schema.org location data.

sources.name: Personio
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. XML, not JSON. Descriptions nest two levels down under jobDescriptions/jobDescription/value. The only platform of the six that states years of experience as its own field.

sources.name: Workday CXS
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-24 against GEICO. Public candidate CXS JSON POST; exact host, tenant and career-site path come from a real posting URL.

sources.name: iCIMS
sources.notes: The official Job Portal API requires Basic authentication. Public career pages remain a later tenant-specific parser rather than a falsely anonymous API connector.

sources.name: SAP SuccessFactors
sources.notes: Career Site Builder serves RSS at /services/rss/job/ on the employer's own career hostname, which is also the token. Not JSON. NOT a complete board listing: it carries the most recent items, so the connector reports complete=False and its postings never feed the staleness sweep. 48 other candidate career hostnames were probed and run something else at the same address.

sources.name: Oracle Recruiting Cloud
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-24 against Oracle's CX_1 candidate site. Anonymous requisition list requires expand=requisitionList and finder-scoped site, limit and offset.
